title: Finite constructible complex hearts and their filtered presentations
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a scheme. Use the finite constant scalar-model constructible modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] in $\mathcal A_X=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ and cochain complexes of [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. A finite constructible complex is a cochain complex $K^\bullet$ in $\mathcal A_X$ whose terms are constructible and for which there is a finite subset $S\subset\mathbf Z$ with $K^n=0$ for $n\notin S$. Its differentials are arbitrary module-sheaf maps. Define $\mathcal H_X$ to be the replete class of modules isomorphic to $H^0(K^\bullet)=\ker(d^0)/\operatorname{im}(d^{-1})$ for such a complex; impose no constructibility condition on this cohomology. Define $\mathcal I_X$ as the replete class of small filtered ambient colimits of modules in $\mathcal H_X$, using [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The indexing universe is the same fixed universe as the module Hom sets, and arrows are arbitrary module maps, with no lift to complexes required.
